newsitem.title: UK: S&P rates Anglian Water 150 mln stg bond.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates Anglian Water 150 mln stg bond.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Wednesday it assigned its AA minus senior unsecured rating to Anglian Water Plc's 150 million stg bonds due 2006.
"The outlook on the rating is stable," S&P said in a statement.

"Anglian's robust financial profile and stable operating environment should provide the company with a fair degree of insulation from the impact of key regulatory and political event risks going forward," the agency said.
"Nonetheless, the potential for a sudden decline in credit quality still exists should a takeover of aggressive windfall tax on utilities materialise in the future," S&P said.
